content.short: Danketsu is a multimedia Web3 IP project combining NFTs, comics, toys, music, games, phygitals, and systems.
content.description: Danketsu is a multimedia Web3 intellectual-property project that has expanded across NFTs, comics, toys, music, gaming, books, and phygital collectibles. The project focuses on building a sustainable brand around community-powered decision making and cross-chain blockchain integrations. Rather than treating NFTs as a standalone drop, Danketsu uses them as part of a wider entertainment and merchandise ecosystem. Its Cardano presence connects collectible ownership with storytelling, products, and long-term IP development.
